input.quote: MSL will provide replacement value insurance coverage for consigned Products. IBM will be named as a joint insured with respect to consigned Products for its interest.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no vendor insurance article. The only insurance references are asset-specific: replacement-value cover for consigned Products with IBM as joint insured (§13.1(b), p0909), IBM-owned tooling insurance carried by IBM (§21.2, p1107), and freight/NIC insurance built into price (§10.5, p0863; Attachment 1 §1.15, p0649). None of these provides commercial general liability, professional (E&O), cyber/privacy or workers' compensation cover, nor certificates on request. MSL is an outsourcing vendor that holds our consigned inventory, occupies leased premises and accesses our I/T systems, so the fallback (E&O and cyber) is not met either. We therefore insert a short Section 16.22 at the preferred level in the GENERAL article, with the cyber trigger drafted to reach all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for IBM.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 16.22 (Insurance) in the GENERAL article requiring MSL to carry CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation coverage and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no general insurance article even though MSL holds our consigned inventory, works with our premises and accesses our I/T systems, so we added our standard coverage requirements. We can discuss lower E&O and cyber limits if MSL's programme is constrained.

ops.text: Insurance. MSL shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than U.S. $1,000,000 per occurrence and U.S. $2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than U.S. $2,000,000; where MSL processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for IBM, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than U.S. $5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. MSL shall provide certificates of insurance to IBM on request.
